title: CI builds, checks and pushes the computer image on every merge to develop
description: Done in PR 501. The image had been pushed by hand five times; twice it was stale or broken. build-computer-image-development.yml builds arm64 on a native runner, checks gcc, node, git, the chatticus-shell user and the owner container test, then pushes sha-<commit> and dev through the OIDC deploy role and verifies the digests match. First run 2026-10-11 succeeded in about 2 minutes. Open: deploy the account deploy stack once so the role stack matches the code (the role is already admin, so no effect); the deploy role itself being AdministratorAccess should be tightened later; GitHub keeps one pending run per concurrency group so a run can be cancelled by a queued deploy (dispatch it again).
right_now_summary: The CI image workflow works; the account deploy stack still needs one deployment.
